title: Portfolio rebalancing
description: Define buckets with target weights (summing to 100%) and which tickers belong to each bucket. The comparison below shows the current allocation, the drift, and a concrete buy/sell suggestion in {currency}. An action is only suggested once the configured tolerance is exceeded.
presetToast: {count} buckets prefilled from {source} (equal-weighted). Not yet saved.
noBuckets: No buckets yet. Use "New bucket" or prefill from sectors/regions.
tickersPlaceholder: Tickers, comma-separated — e.g. AAPL, MSFT, SAP.DE
tolerance: Tolerance (drift in percentage points before an action is suggested):
unassignedHint: These tickers are in your portfolio but not assigned to any bucket — they are not considered during rebalancing.
